justification: Assessment reported INVALID and localized the defect to the p=0 case being routed into the Jensen branch built on phi(x)=x^{q/p}, whose exponent q/p is undefined when p=0. That is exactly the ground-truth flaw ('in the stated zero-exponent case, phi(x)=x^{q/p} is well-defined... and can be used in Jensen's inequality'). Its witness p=0, q=1 (with x=(1,4)) is the same witness family as the ground truth's p=0, q=1, x=1: q/p = 1/0 has no real value. Additional secondary defect claimed about the equality clause does not change the match.
